title: Every drilling crew suffers equipment failure

tellings.quote: boring. We start drilling. Well, every drilling expert, and I'm talking every one of them that we brought out, has had dramatic equipment malfunction.

plain: On the mesa at Skinwalker Ranch, a Utah property famous for strange happenings, every drilling expert brought in to bore into the ground has had dramatic equipment failures, according to the ranch's owner. He tells it as something he has watched happen, and it feeds his claim that something lies hidden under the ranch.
